reuseAssessment: Useful evidence taxonomy, validators, gate states, task binding, replay tests, graph/drift/health, and proposal review can inform a future evidence engine. Reuse requires trusted/signed issuers, universal task/runtime/commit binding, immutable durable records, safe command execution with runCommands disabled by default, and an unavoidable fail-closed caller contract.
